description: MOSS voice design model: creates a speaker from a written instruction instead of a reference recording, then speaks the supplied text in that voice.

request.name: min_frames
request.description: Minimum generated audio frames per text chunk; nonpositive values derive a text-length-based floor.

request.name: max_frames
request.description: Generated audio-frame ceiling per text chunk; nonpositive values derive a text-length-based ceiling. Runtime raises it to at least the effective min_frames plus the number of codebooks.

request.name: instruct
request.description: Voice description: timbre, age, pace, emotion.

request.name: text_temperature
request.description: Text-token sampling temperature. Must be finite and positive when sampling.

request.name: language
request.description: Optional full language name, such as English or Chinese; not an ISO language code.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed; later text chunks add their chunk index. Parsed as signed 32-bit integer then converted to uint32; negative values wrap.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Audio-token sampling temperature. Must be finite and positive when sampling.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Audio-token repetition penalty. Must be finite and positive when history is nonempty.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum characters per generated text chunk; must be positive.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Backbone weight storage. f16 is not supported.
